highlights: Staff background checks conducted before employment
Continuous student supervision across classrooms, breaks, and entrances
Visitor pass system and mandatory escorts for external visitors
Dedicated Child Protection Officer (CPO) and Safeguarding Log
Child Protection and Safeguarding CPD for teaching staff
safety.policy_summary: Bloomsbury International School Hatyai maintains a comprehensive safeguarding and child protection policy to ensure physical, emotional, and cultural safety. This includes mandatory staff background checks, continuous monitoring of entrances and visitors, structured reporting systems via a Child Protection Officer, and regular staff CPD training.
